Ireland visit visa from Pakistan — Not Schengen — separate UK-adjacent visit route

Ireland is outside the Schengen Area. Pakistani visitors need the Irish short-stay permission route — do not confuse a Schengen visa with legal entry to Ireland.

Where Pakistanis apply (Ireland)

Irish visa applications from Pakistan are submitted through VFS Global for the Irish Naturalisation and Immigration Service (INIS) process.

Centres: Islamabad · Karachi. Confirm the live centre list before paying travel costs to a VAC city.

Tourism visits

Tourism itineraries for Dublin and regions with hotels and return ties.

Family visits

Family visit invitations per Irish checklist; relationship and host status proof.

Short business visits with Irish company letters and Pakistani employer NOC.

Pakistan-side refusal risks

  • Assuming UK visa covers Ireland
  • Assuming Schengen visa covers Ireland
  • Weak purpose for long stays
  • Unexplained financial spikes

Funds and credibility

Show funds for Irish daily costs plus ongoing Pakistan commitments; INIS examines credibility closely.

Visit vs study / work

Short visits cannot replace student residence or work permits. For degrees see Ireland study visa. Work needs correct authorization — work permit hub.

Official Ireland links · Ireland visit checklist · refusal reasons · appointment guides

Cover letter outline (Ireland visit from Pakistan)

  1. Your role in Pakistan (job, business, study) with contactable employer
  2. Exact travel dates aligned with insurance and hotel/invite
  3. Day-level plan for Ireland cities — not a generic “Europe tour”
  4. Who pays, with six-month bank trail explaining any large deposits
  5. Why you return (dependents, property, business continuity, studies)
  6. Prior visas/refusals stated calmly with what changed

First-time travellers from Pakistan

No prior visas is not automatic refusal, but first files need clearer employment proof and realistic trip length. Prior compliant Schengen/UK/US travel helps when explained; unexplained gaps hurt.

Children and family groups

Carry birth certificates and school leave letters. Group itineraries must show every traveller’s ties — not only the primary applicant’s job letter.

After a refusal

Read the refusal letter themes before reapplying. Fixing only the appointment slot without stronger purpose, funds or ties usually fails again. See visit refusal reasons and what next.
